The Celebrity Chef Challenge features six professional chefs in a timed culinary competition with surprise ingredients ala the Iron Chef Television Show. Chefs have 45 minutes to turn five secret ingredients into three power-packed dishes in front of one live audience!

But there’s more…as chefs battle to determine, “whose cuisines reigns supreme,” guests enjoy samples from over 100 restaurants, wineries, and breweries while touring the automotive excellence housed by the California Automobile Museum!

We hope your taste buds are ready, because this is one evening you won’t want to miss!

2011 Celebrity Chef Challengers:
-From the Black Sheep Butchery, Executive Chef Mark Liberman
-From Table 260, Executive Chef Richard Pannell
-From Colusa Casino Resort, Executive Chef Keith Erickson
-From Evan’s Kitchen, Executive Chef Evan Elsberry
-From the Vizcaya Pavilion and Mansion, Executive Chef Jim Turknett
-From the Tequila Museo Mayahuel, Executive Chef Ramiro Alarcon

The Celebrity Chef Challenge would not be possible without the continued support of Sacramento & Company/News 10, Preferred Meats, Pacific Fresh Seafood, General Produce and Mani Imports.

title: Art Q&A
description:
Discover the essence of the art on view in tours that emphasize looking, conversation, and group interaction.

Free with Museum admission.

title: Native Peoples Lecture & Book Signing with Dr. Alan P. Garfinkel
description:
The State Indian Museum is proud to host a special Native Peoples lecture and book signing opportunity with Dr. Alan P. Garfinkel, who co-authored the recently-released book titled Handbook of the Kawaiisu with Harold Williams, Kawaiisu elder. During his insightful and compelling lecture, Dr. Garfinkel will relate the remarkable story of the Kawaiisu people who shared memories, culture, and beliefs with him during the research for and development of this unique handbook.

Guests are invited to the State Indian Museum to learn more about the cultural heritage and resilient legacy of the Native Peoples who still live in the Tehachapi region with a tale dating back centuries. Due to seating limitations, advance reservations are recommended by calling the number below.

title: The Lisa Project
description:
The Lisa Project is a unique, interactive, multi-sensory exhibit experience allowing the visitor to hear, see, and experience the reality of the world of child abuse, taking you beyond the headlines and statistics about child abuse. Through audio narration from a child's perspective, visitors are guided room by room through scenarios depicting abuse, taking a journey through the lives of abused children. This experience is fully immersing each guest into the world that these children face on a daily basis. The result of this experience is a community that is made more aware with positive and helpful steps given at the end of the tour to protect children and strengthen families.

This exhibit coincides with National Child Abuse Prevention Month. At no other time has anyone had the chance to understand the plight of these children and to experience it through their eyes, their ears, and their emotions. The Lisa Project promises to raise awareness through education as you “take a child by the hand” and listen to their story. Everything you thought you knew about child abuse is about to change.

The exhibit is rated PG-13 due to some mature content. Children under 13 that come with guardians or parents will be allowed to walk through the exhibit but will not be given an audio device.

title: Trains and Tripods
description: The program begins with an optional seminar on museum photography led by former Sacramento Bee photographer and Canon USA consultant Dave Henry. Join amateur photographers of all skill levels as cameras and tripods are welcomed into the Museum (prior to opening hours) the following day. This unique opportunity will allow you to create photographs without worrying about people tripping over your tripod or unexpectedly entering your scene.

title: The Central Valley Turns On: Psychedelic Poster Art, 1965-1975
description: This winter, The California Museum is proud to partner with poster art historians Alisa Leslie and Walter Medeiros to present an exhibit featuring poster art work from the 1960s and 1970s. The artwork promoting Psychedelic rock music was as revolutionary as the music itself: wild colors, strange images, dynamic composition, and hand-drawn lettering that could be either gracefully decorative or compacted into dense, nearly unreadable patterns. This exhibit features promotional posters and handbills that originated from the dance and concert venues of the Central Valley many of which have not been publicly displayed since they were made in the 1960s and 1970s.

title: 26th Annual Docent Training Class
description:
Take part in the 21-week 26th Annual Docent Training Class program. The Museum is seeking men and women interested in automobiles and their history who wish to become docents. Docents are volunteer teachers/tour guides who interpret the Museum's story to people from around the globe.

The California Automobile Museum's world-recognized docent course is a unique and enjoyable educational experience as well as an opportunity to get involved as a key volunteer in a fascinating Museum. The fee covers the extensive course materials and a year’s Individual Membership in the California Vehicle Foundation, host organization to the California Automobile Museum. Scholarships may be requested. Being a docent is a wonderful opportunity to meet interesting people and talk cars and car lore.

title: Plein Aire Day
description: Northern California Artists come together to spend the day painting the beautiful landscape and historic buildings in the park surrounding the Museum.

title: The Pixar Collection
description: The California State Railroad Museum will host a special event with Stage Nine Gallery, presenting Disney’s Fine Art – The Pixar Collection, a fine art collection inspired by the films of Pixar Animation Studios. Twelve artists portray the stories of Pixar’s eleven modern animation classics through fine art. View the art collection and meet the artists in person.

title: John Buck: Iconography
description: John Buck: Iconography comes from the Collections of Jordan D. Schnitzer and His Family Foundation. Over the past four decades, Iowa-born artist John Buck has created an important body of woodblock prints, sculptures, and three-dimensional wood panels, all of which will be featured in this exhibition. Tough-minded and visually complex, his art comprises a thorough and relentless examination of deeply personal and shared social concerns.

title: Get On Board: Stories of the LA to Houston Freedom Riders
description:
Get On Board: Stories of the Los Angeles to Houston Freedom Ride recounts the seldom-heard story of CORE’s (Congress of Racial Equality) freedom ride from Los Angeles, California, to Houston, Texas, in August 1961. Commemorating the 50th anniversary of the freedom rides, this exhibit underscores the ambitious optimism that inspired 11 Californians--both black and white, men and women--to leave their schools, families, and homes to get on board a train for a ride to secure freedom and liberty for all Americans during the Civil Rights Movement.

Inspired by Houston’s Union Station, the exhibit features a U-shaped lunch counter with six counter stools that serves as a display area for artifacts that relate the courageous stories of the California Freedom Riders such as:
-Newspaper clips detailing contrasting historical perspectives from Los Angeles Times & Houston Chronicle
-Photographs & political buttons from original Freedom Rider Ellen Broms’ personal collection
-1961 UCLA oral history & manuscripts written by original Freedom Rider Steven McNichols

The exhibition is presented in partnership with the California Legislative Black Caucus and the Mayme Clayton Library and Museum.

title: Rails and Reels: Hollywood, Trains and the Making of Motion Pictures
description: Learn how Hollywood and America’s railroads have had a love affair since the very beginning of motion picture history, and how that attraction has continued through Westerns and into modern times as part of Sci-Fi and dramatic action-packed thrillers. See original scripts, sheet music, movie posters, lobby cards and movie- and television-related artifacts from the collections of the California State Railroad Museum and Railtown 1897 State Historic Park in Jamestown. And, learn how famous Sierra Railway “Movie Star” steam locomotive No. 3—which has starred in dozens of motion pictures and television shows—is returning to the rails at Railtown 1897 State Historic Park after a million dollar makeover, ready for more starring roles once again.

title: Meet the Author: Stephen Harding
description:
On Dec. 7, 1941, even as Japanese carrier-launched aircraft were winging their way toward Pearl Harbor, a small American cargo ship chartered by the U.S. Army reported it was being attacked by a submarine about halfway between Seattle and Honolulu. After that one cryptic message the humble lumber carrier Cynthia Olson and her crew vanished without a trace, their disappearance all but forgotten as the mighty warships of the U.S. Pacific Fleet burned.

Though long relegated to footnote status in Pacific War histories, the story of Cynthia Olson's mid-ocean encounter with the Japanese submarine I-26 is both a classic high-seas drama and one of the most enduring mysteries of World War II. Did Commander Minoru Yokota of I-26 disregard orders and sink the freighter before the attack on Pearl Harbor began, running the risk of alerting the Americans to the impending assault? Did master mariner Berthel Carlsen and his 34-man crew survive their vessel's sinking only to drift away into the vast Pacific, or were they machine gunned in their lifeboats at the orders of Yokota, who after the war became a devout Christian? Was Cynthia Olson the first American casualty of the Pacific War, and could her SOS have changed the course of history?

Based on years of research, Voyage to Oblivion explores both the military and human aspects of the Cynthia Olson story, bringing to life a complex tale of courage, tenacity, hubris, and arrogance in the opening hours of America's war in the Pacific.

About the Author: Stephen Harding is author of numerous books including Great Liners at War. He is a war correspondent and journalist and lives in Virginia, USA.

title: Casino Royale on the River: Old Sacramento Meets Monte Carlo!
description:
Join us aboard the Empress Hornblower at Old Sacramento’s waterfront and immerse yourself in the full casino experience on three decks brimming with fun, food, entertainment, and adventure. Arrive in black tie optional or historic attire and you’ll be greeted by both the Captain of the ship and the music of the Gold Rush era as you receive a glass of Sacramento’s newest signature drink, The Gold Rush. As you enter the boat, each floor takes you on a trip to fun and excitement. Enjoy 1850’s style gambling at our first floor casino; on the 2nd floor you’ll delight in a taste of James Bond cuisine; finally dance under the stars on our modern rooftop lounge as we glide along the Sacramento River.

All proceeds from the event will benefit the educational and interpretive programs of the Historic Old Sacramento Foundation (HOSF).

title: “The Great Dreamer and The Great Doer: Theodore Roosevelt’s Impassioned Life” Exhibit
description: With a passion for nature and conservation, Theodore Roosevelt’s life was filled with big dreams and great accomplishments. To learn more about his life and impact on California, you are invited to visit an inspiring new exhibit titled “The Great Dreamer and The Great Doer: Theodore Roosevelt’s Impassioned Live” opening at the Leland Stanford Mansion State Historic Park. Artifacts from Roosevelt’s 1903 trip out west, compelling images and campaign memorabilia will be on display as part of this special exhibit.
venue: Leland Stanford Mansion State Historic Park

title: American Muscle
description: Explore the birth and evolution of American muscles cars from the 1960s to present day and the impact on popular culture and automotive technology.

title: Meaning and Medium
description:
This exhibition explores the diversity of media in art, including photography, painting, sculpture, and mixed media. Pieces on display include work from various Sacramento-area high schools.

This exhibit is part of the Student & Community Exhibition Galleries.

title: Extreme Engineering: The California State Water Project Past, Present, and Future
description: This hands-on, interactive exhibit explores the complexities of water in California. Visitors will discover the world's largest manmade water system and the people behind its creation, and be challenged to actively consider the choices facing policy makers today. A big-screen flyover will take them from the nation's tallest dam to its longest aqueduct, while artifacts and interviews reveal how the California Water Project--celebrating its 50th birthday in 2010--changed the way we live in the Golden State.

title: Daniel Douke: Bytes of Reality
description: Southern California artist Daniel Douke responds to everyday experience by rendering the transient packaging of consumer products—particularly the box. At first glance, Douke's boxes appear to be simply found objects—à la Marcel Duchamp. They are anything but. These are paintings that are rendered in exquisite detail, with text, packaging tape, smudges, and dents all carefully observed and painted. Even the canvas is stretched and shaped to perfection. By making these discarded boxes art, he gives them permanence and value, challenging our assumptions about reality and artifice. This exhibition features 24 of his works.

title: The Photosynthetic Restaurant: Gourmet Sunlight for Plants, Cuisine by Jonathon Keats
description: Jonathon Keats, a conceptual artist, fabulist, and critic, has developed a gourmet cuisine for the world’s first photosynthetic restaurant, set in the floral plantings in front of the historic Art Gallery building of the Crocker Art Museum.

title: A Most Glorious Heritage: The Grandeur and History of California State Parks
description:
The California State Capitol Museum, managed and operated by California State Parks, shows "A Most Glorious Heritage: The Grandeur and History of California State Parks," a new exhibit featuring the diversity of state parks and its early pioneers, as well as how the system continues to evolve and promote environmental awareness while meeting the public's demand for recreation, experiences in nature and preservation of cultural heritage. This new exhibit chronicles the rich history of the California State Parks system since its inception in the 1860s through today.

Planned in coordination with a one-hour movie showcasing California State Parks currently in development and scheduled to be released later in 2010, the exhibit demonstrates the vision and collective commitment it has taken over time to build the California State Parks system. The system has preserved a legacy of diverse beauty for generations of Californians and visitors to experience and enjoy.

The exhibit is located in the Archives Exhibit Room (Room 105) of the California State Capitol Museum.

title: California Admission Day Celebration
description: Birthday cake and ice cream will be served to celebrate California’s 161st year of Statehood.

title: Trains and Tripods
description: The program begins with an optional seminar on museum photography led by former Sacramento Bee photographer and Canon USA consultant Dave Henry. Join amateur photographers of all skill levels as cameras and tripods are welcomed into the Museum (prior to opening hours) the following day. This unique opportunity will allow you to create photographs without worrying about people tripping over your tripod or unexpectedly entering your scene.

title: A Taste of History
description: Historic recipes are recreated with a modern twist by Sacramento’s top chefs. A benefit for the Friends of Sutter’s Fort, this event celebrates the culinary history of the region, merged with the Slow Food movement that promotes organic, sustainable food production, much like it was in the heyday of the Fort.

title: California Automobile Museum’s Fall Swap Meet
description:
Vendors will offer unique and hard to find automobile collectibles and accessories, including antique auto parts, tools, books, magazines, models, and much more! Located next to the Museum at 2400 Front Street-- parking in Museum parking lot, on the street, and behind the Museum.

Set-up and merchant and car sales registration will be on Sat, Oct 1 from 2pm-5pm. Merchant stalls (one stall is two parking spaces) are $30 and car sale spaces are $15.

Proceeds benefit the Museum.

title: Women’s Vote in California: 100 Year Anniversary “We Won the Vote!”
description: Come celebrate the 100 year anniversary of the women’s vote in California when California State Capitol Museum docents present living history performances that were researched, written, and produced specifically to commemorate this important event. Your tour will encounter Governors, politicians, and key women suffragists, all in period-appropriate costume. Witness the dramatic recreation of several episodes that led to women getting the vote in California.

title: California Automobile Museum’s Annual Fundraising Dinner
description: Spend an evening raising funds for the California Automobile Museum.

title: The California Hall of Fame 2010
description:
Celebrating the class of 2010 California Hall of Fame, this year’s exhibition is over 3,000-square feet. It's the most exciting exhibition yet honoring this year’s inductees, and includes more than 100 unique items, many of which have never been publicly displayed such as:

-The recreated office of Governor Edmund G. “Pat” Brown containing desk, chair, lamp, blotter, and a marlin caught by the former California governor
-Props used in the blockbuster films of James Cameron, including maquettes and spears from Avatar, life-size Terminator statue, machine from Aliens, ship's wheel, and engine wheel from Titanic, and more
-The restored 1933 Lincoln automobile owned by Bank of America founder and father of modern banking, A.P. Giannini
-Custom suit, gold records, and Fender Haggard Tuff Dog guitar played by country music legend Merle Haggard
-Several costumes worn by music and film icon Barbra Streisand in On a Clear Day You Can See Forever, My Name Is Barbra, and Yentl; her first contract with the Bon Soir; albums, tickets, movie posters, and rare Broadway billboard from Funny Girl
-Wayne Thiebaud gallery personally containing works selected by the artist himself
-The pilot script from Golden Girls signed by the original cast and an Emmy won by comedienne Betty White

And much, much more!

title: Arts & Crafts Holiday Fair
description: Native artisans from all over California offer their wares for sale each year on the two days following Thanksgiving. Enjoy browsing through jewelry, basketry, pottery, hand-painted gourds, ornaments, and much more, as you select those just-right gifts for the holidays. Free with museum admission.

title: Holiday Music Program
description: Get ready for some holiday fun on your next visit to the California State Capitol Museum! To set a festive stage and spread holiday cheer, beautiful vintage decorations create a lovely backdrop for a variety of diverse and amazing live holiday musical performances in the Capitol Rotunda each day.

title: Uprooted! The Japanese Americans During WWII
description: This exhibit features the Japanese American community from immigration and internment during World War II, to their struggle and success in seeking redress for the loss of their constitutional rights. This display, featuring photographs, art, furniture, and crafts made in the internment camps, is drawn from the rich Japanese American Archival Collection developed by the local Japanese American community and housed at Sacramento State. Uprooted offers a unique opportunity to learn about the experiences of people who have struggled and triumphed in claiming their place in California history and their rights as Americans.

title: California’s Remarkable Women
description:
California has always been replete with remarkable women. As community leaders and activists, inventors and entertainers, as mothers, daughters, sisters, and partners, California’s remarkable women serve 24/7 on the front lines of humanity.

Extraordinary women from every walk of life strengthen, shape, and serve our great state. California’s Remarkable Women honors their significant roles and achievements, drawing its inspiration from past and present achievements of California women. In doing so, it delivers an energetic message about the limitless opportunities and possibilities awaiting present and future generations of women leaders.

From farm worker organizer Dolores Huerta to actress Elizabeth Taylor, the exhibit includes approximately 200 remarkable California women. The exhibit also invites museum visitors to nominate the remarkable women they know or know about.

The exhibit is presented by California First Lady Maria Shriver, in partnership with the California Museum, the Office of the Secretary of State, and the California Department of Parks and Recreation.

title: Minerva Awards
description: Founded in 2004 by California First Lady Maria Shriver, the Minerva Awards, named for the Roman goddess who graces the California State Seal, honor women who have stepped forward in the spirit of Minerva and changed our world with their courage, their strength, and their wisdom. The annual awards celebrate women who work to make this world a more compassionate, tolerant and just place. This conference-funded exhibit chronicles their lasting legacies.

title: Pick Me! Fruit Crate Art & The California Dream
description: The California State Railroad Museum’s new exhibit Pick Me! Fruit Crate Art & The California Dream is based on the museum’s and the California State Library's collection of gorgeous fruit and vegetable crate labels. Dripping with color, their vibrant hues and often whimsical motifs will draw you in but it’s the story behind the labels that is equally fascinating. Railroads (and later the development of refrigerated cars) made it possible to ship California’s bountiful harvest to a hungry nation. Along with the produce, it was the crate labels that carried the vision of the “California Dream,” a place where it was always sunny and gardens were always greener. Come join the dream as you drink in the magic of California’s early graphic artists and their alluring art.

title: California Indians: Making a Difference
description:
Utilizing the voice and experiences of a diverse California Native Advisory Council, the exhibition highlights the unique contributions of the state’s Native Peoples and represents over 150 tribes from across the state.

Through the sights and sounds of art, photographs, documents, and interactive presentations, California Indians’ stories of cultural adaptation and triumph are told by those who know it best – themselves.

From the influx of Western settlers in the 19th century to urban migration in the 21st century, California Indians have not just survived but thrived in spite of over 200 years under the forces of assimilation. Their extraordinary history perpetuates the Golden State’s legacy of cultural diversity and resilience, revealing that California’s first inhabitants are as relevant to the present as they are to the past.

This permanent exhibit program will feature new artifacts during its second installation phase in 2012.

title: “Californians Over There! California’s Role in the First World War” Exhibit
description: This exhibit will explore the contributions made by California’s Doughboys in the world-wide conflict known as the Great War/World War I. Shoulder-to-shoulder with their French and British allies, Californians bravely served in the trenches of Europe, against their axis foes. This exhibit will feature historic World War I flags, uniforms, and weapons to illustrate the compelling story of our boys “Over There.”

title: David Wilcox
description:
"For any singer-songwriter to be able to muster passion, hope, and grace after 15 years in the unsung folk genre is an accomplishment and, as such, David Wilcox is infinitely accomplished." -Paste Magazine

Also playing:
Raina Rose (Folk, Singer-Songwriter)

title: Chickading
description: Celebrate 1st Thursdays with Chickading! Featuring PG13, Triple Nickel, and DJ Mike Rodriguez.

title: Lights Down Low with Juan MacLean
description:
M!X Downtown, Big Stereo, and Rough House present the grand opening of Lights Down Low! First on the decks is special guest DJ Juan MacLean. Plus resident DJs Shaun Slaughter, Adam J, and Alx-T spinning house music and other dance floor gems.

Juan MacLean is one of the hugest names in dance. Signed to James Murphy's (LCD Soundsystem) label DFA Records, he has released some of the most important dance floor smashers of the last six years. Tracks like "Happy House," "The Simple Life," and "Give Me Every Little Thing" have been charted by all the top names in dance.

Prior to becoming one of the most significant names on the DFA label, John MacLean was a member of Sub Pop band Six Finger Satellite. When Six Finger Satellite broke up, MacLean's aggravated emotional state and long-term drug addiction took him low enough to provoke a move from New York to New Hampshire and a drastic change in lifestyle. Murphy and Tim Goldsworthy, who were getting the DFA label off the ground, provoked MacLean to become interested in making music again. Using the name the Juan MacLean, MacLean took the sound of his defunct band to the dancefloor, retaining flashes of post-punk and '70s experimental electronics while grafting bits of early Euro-disco, electro, Detroit techno, and Chicago house.

title: I Love House: The Crystal Method
description: Enjoy a house & electronic DJ set by The Crystal Method. Hosted by: Stephanie Weaver, Ron Reeser, Jetset Nights, Mixture Ent. (Mixing House and Electronic Music all night.) I Love House brings different guests every Thursday to District 30.

title: CinemaSpeak: Magnolia
description:
CinemaSpeak is a free film screening and discussion event featuring movies making an impact on our society. This month will we be viewing Magnolia. Through chance, human action, past history, and divine intervention, an eclectic cast of characters (including Tom Cruise, Julianne Moore, William H. Macy, and more) weaves and warps through each other's lives on a random day in San Fernando Valley, building to an unforgettable climax. Paul Thomas Anderson writes and directs this thought-provoking mosaic of American life, woven through a series of comedic and poignant vignettes.

Moderator Jeremy Maron is a 19-year film industry veteran with the last 12 in video distribution. Both a fan and student of cinema, Jeremy believes that film is art and cinema is social commentary. His various interviews with actors, directors, and producers can be found here.

Space is limited, so please be sure to RSVP via the link below. CinemaSpeak is a RetroJam Production.

title: The Sleeprockers
description: The Sleeprockers: DJs Rated R, Mr.Vibe, Nocturnal, Kwes the Bess, and special guest host Ospis of ARG, live at the Blue Lamp. Come out and experience a DJ night like no other: six turntables, three mixers, live MPC production, and a whole lot of Sleeprocking all in unison! Free give-aways all night from RANE, Wicked Audio, and more.

title: Tony Bataska
description: Enjoy an acoustic performance by singer-songwriter Tony Bataska.

title: Rough House & Record Club
description:
F*ck Fridays has been reborn into two parties--The Rough House & Record Club. You'll still enjoy two floors of debauchery, drinking, dancing, and euphoria every Friday night! Themed parties, live performances from world class DJs and bands, and total insanity.

The Rough House is downstairs with resident DJs: Shaun Slaughter (D.A.M.B/Lipstick/Golden Bear Thursdays), Adam J, and Taylor spinning weirdo house, hyper techno, and indie dance and bass on a laser-lit, strobe-kissed, LED brightened dance floor.

Upstairs is Record Club, featuring Roger Carpio (Record Club/Lipstick) spinning indie rock & pop and alternative classics with a side of soul.

Themed evenings curated by Busted. Amazing sound and lighting by the X-GVNR. Door by Missy Mark.

title: Blackeyed Dempseys & Tater Famine
description:
Blackeyed Dempseys flawlessly blend the Irish tradition with power-packed pub punk. Their shows are a rocking Celtic explosions featuring musical fireworks and first rate performances.

Also playing:
Tater Famine

title: Cash'd Out: Johnny Cash Tribute Band
description: Cash'd Out is the premier Johnny Cash tribute band in the world, bar none. They are the only tribute band endorsed by and linked to the official Johnny Cash website. Cash'd Out live shows respectfully reference the late, great Man in Black's early Columbia era and Sun Records sound, combined with the energy of the classic multi-platinum live recordings from Folsom Prison and San Quentin.

title: Rademacher & Pets
description:
Rademacher is an indie rock band from Fresno, California. They have toured the West Coast with bands including Silversun Pickups, The Joggers, Earlimart, and Man Man. They released three EPs between 2004 and 2006, as well as their first full-length album in December 2007.

Allison Jones and Derek Fieth formed the duo known as Pets in the summer of 2003. Since their inception, they've amassed a sizeable loyal following due to their energetic live shows, and shared the stage with such notable, national acts as The Gossip, Matt & Kim, Dead Meadow, and Spindrift.

title: 2nd Friday ArtAbout
description:
2nd Friday ArtAbout is a monthly evening of art viewing and artists’ receptions at galleries and businesses in Downtown Davis and beyond. All events are free and open to the public--many include a chance to meet and greet featured artists, enjoy refreshments, live music, art demos, and more. This month there are 25 participating venues with outdoor modern dance performances around Downtown as well.

To get a schedule, which changes every 2nd Friday, visit here, or e-mail the address below. Also, download a map.

title: Jackie Greene
description: Discovered at an open mike night, singer/songwriter Jackie Greene is a captivating performer who works well in simple, sparse environments. A multi-instrumentalist, Greene played most of the instruments on his debut record, Gone Wanderin'. A soulful bit of roots music, the album brought him to a national audience and sprung him into a college tour during the fall of 2002. Rusty Nails, a collection of material from 2001, was released by Dig Records in 2003, followed by the live-in-the-studio DVD video Broken Hearts Dusty Roads in 2004. Sweet Somewhere Bound appeared on Dig later that same year, and was licensed to Verve Records, which reissued it in 2005. His first proper album for Verve, American Myth, appeared in 2006. In 2008, Greene released Giving Up the Ghost, his first album for 429 Records. The pop-infused but still heartfelt Till the Light Comes followed in 2010.

title: Mercy Me!
description: Mercy Me! is a band worth listening to--they pride themselves on being an ethically diverse group. Their years of talent and expertise are combined to form a unique, funky, bluesy, and exciting band, pleasing a wide fan base and gaining new fans everywhere they perform.

title: Bitch & The Chick P's
description:
Armed with an electric violin, a ukulele, and a bass guitar, Bitch (formerly of Bitch and Animal), is on the road and rampage again with a fistful of new songs from her upcoming debut solo release, Make this/Break this. She is an entertainer and songwriter who has pulled audiences to their feet worldwide with her politically charged and personally wrenched lyrics, her atypical instrumentation, minimalist sound, and wildly dramatic stage persona.

What makes a band demand your attention…ignite, excite, and draw you in? Is it heart-breaking harmonies? Stand-out vocals? Emotion drenched lyrics? High-energy performances? Screaming guitar solos? Rocking originals and covers that force you to get up and dance? The Chick P’s bring all of this and more. A fun, spirited, rock and blues band made up of four chicks and a guy named Guy, the band’s guitar muse. They are pound for pound, a contagiously fun, feel-good band!

title: MonoMyth Inception & Truth of Mars
description:
MonoMyth Inception has collaborated their styles and diverse musical backgrounds into a modern rock sound. Straight outta Sacramento, they continue to mold their style into a fun, party type of music with elements of highs and lows. MonoMyth Inception is on a musical journey to excellence, paving the road with fun and collaboration.

Truth of Mars is a blend of alternative, pop, and rock music. Their exploration of melody provides compositions that sound like U2, Radiohead, and Sonic Youth.

Also performing:
Jay Shaner

title: Anthony Cavazos Lovelorn Duo
description: Anthony Cavazos is a singer-songwriter in San Francisco.

title: Drastic Actions, Get Shot!, Kill Devil, The Number 13
description:
Drastic Actions is an '80s hardcore punk band from Sacramento.

Also playing:
Get Shot!
Kill Devil
The Number 13

title: A Hawaiian Evening with Makana
description: Art and life are one. Makana says "Inspiration stems from art's potential to ignite curiosity, the seed of transcendence. I am a native of Hawai'i and a citizen of the Earth; my music is guided by a burning desire to merge the cultural heritage of my kupuna (elders) with global themes, weaving the roots of Hawai'i's vast musical palette into a universal sound that includes influences from rock, bluegrass, African, Latin, Celtic, modern, and folk music traditions."

title: Laughing Matters Comedy Night
description:
FOX40 and BloodSource present an entire evening of full-on comedic hilarity, live on-stage. Two of the funniest men you will ever meet will have you rolling in the aisles all night long. Both Dave Coulier and Jack Gallagher have enjoyed brilliant careers, entertaining audiences live and on television. Now is your chance to see them both on the same stage along with Master of Ceremonies Paul Robins.

VIP seats include a special preshow VIP reception with wine and hors d’oeuvres, meet & greet with Dave, Jack, and Paul, and more.

Proceeds benefit the UC Davis Children’s Hospital Pediatric Intensive Care Unit and the Foundation for America’s Blood Centers. Best of all, your generosity will make it possible for others to laugh again.

title: Anthony Jeselnik
description:
Anthony Jeselnik's pitch-black sense of humor, brilliant joke writing, and devilish charm has made him a smash hit in the alternative comedy community. This year, Variety named Anthony as one of "10 Comics to Watch" and Comedy Central picked Anthony as one of nine comics for Comedy Central's Hot List.

Anthony has appeared as a stand-up on Down and Dirty with Jim Norton (HBO), Late Night with Conan O'Brien (NBC), Premium Blend (Comedy Central), Jimmy Kimmel Live (ABC) and Last Call with Carson Daly (NBC). Last year, Anthony developed a project based on his stand-up for MTV. He also wrote for Sarah Silverman for her stints on this year's MTV Movie Awards and MTV Video Music Awards, as well as on Night of Too Many Stars for Comedy Central.

title: Fascination
description: Fascination is not your typical '80s New Wave dance club.

title: DJ E-Rock: 2011 Vegas Edition CD Release Party
description:
Join DJ E-Rock & The Park Ultra Lounge for E-Rock's 2011 Vegas Edition CD release party-Big Boom Sound! There aren't too many 30 year olds with 15 years of professional DJ experience—in fact, San Francisco's DJ E-Rock is probably the only one. For the math-inclined, that means E-Rock got his start on KMEL when he was just 15—the youngest on-air personality in the station's storied history.

From that day, he was on a path towards DJ dominance in the Bay Area and beyond. As the entertainment director for the city's biggest club, host of a hugely popular weekly show on the city's biggest radio station, and stadium DJ for the city's beloved baseball team—there's nothing else to call E-Rock's assent but dominant.

Having earned his chops in the pre-Serato days (carrying crates, stickering exclusive 12-inches, walking uphill in the snow without shoes on), his commitment to the craft hasn't wavered since he was the wide-eyed purist spinning house parties. His revere for the art of DJing is apparent on Club 997 (formerly Club 949), his Friday night radio show on MOViN 99.7 (formerly WiLD 94.9), where he spins and then hosts guest DJs from around the world.

As proud a San Franciscan as they come, E-Rock isn't limiting himself to his hometown. After years of booking his own impressive gigs around the country, he recently signed to Moodswing 360, furthering his reach as a traveling DJ. E-Rock has rocked the turntables for an A-list of clientele, including CC Sabathia, Barry Bonds, Jamie Foxx, Lil Jon, Travis Barker, and Tommy Lee.

title: 2nd Saturday Comedy Night for Japan Disaster Relief
description:
How did Will Ferrell, Kristen Wiig, and Chris Kattan get their start before they became stars on SNL? They studied improv at the Groundlings in L.A.!

Start your 2nd Saturday this April on the right foot--with laughter! The Gym Improv Troupe and Trust Fall Sketch Comedy will provide comic relief to midtown so we can all provide disaster relief to Japan.

The Groundlings students will help raise funds for those affected by the earthquake and tsunami in northern Japan. 100% of the proceeds will go to provide immediate disaster relief and establish long-term reconstruction efforts.

title: Kaye Bohler
description: Kaye's sumptuous voice can be heard in almost any style in almost any setting. From her powerhouse big band, to the soulful blues band to her intimate trio, Kayes style is always authentic and will always leave you wanting more.

title: New Monsoon
description:
New Monsoon represents the best of the San Francisco jam scene. Formed during the El Nino rains of Northern California in the late '90s, this band has distilled their original sound with top-flight musicianship, tireless live performing, and a thoroughly open-minded musical perspective. NM's unique style blends free-flying rock with acoustic stylings, tight vocal harmonies, and lyrical songcraft.

Also performing:
Five Eyed Hand
Jay Dirt

title: The Cash Prophets: A Tribute to Johnny Cash
description:
The Cash Prophets are an amazingly talented Johnny Cash tribute band out of Santa Barbara, California. The band is made up of a father and his two sons and remains true to Cash's early Sun Records recordings. Rockabilly/country/rock.

Also performing:
Matt W. Gage

title: The Cheeseballs
description: The Cheeseballs pride themselves on serving up a helping of non-stop '70s disco, '80s pop classics, hip-hop, rock, and current hits with an uncanny knack for performing songs that everyone knows the words to. The result is always an audience dance and sing along.

title: Hullabaloo! Rock 'n' Roll Dance Night
description: Varieties of pop & rock with a little bit of wacky on top from DJ Hailey. Come hear the tunes live!

title: Simplistic Big Band featuring Anthony Coleman II
description: Five saxes, five trumpets, four trombones, four emcees, two vocalists, full rhythm, beatboxer, and much more make up the Simplistic Big Band, featuring Anthony Coleman II.

title: Sacramento International Film Festival: Environmental Visions
description:
The Sacramento International Film Festival is proud to announce Environmental Visions, a showcase of environmental documentaries from around the world. This years lineup includes Scientists Under Attack, the story of how large agricultural and chemical companies prevent scientists from releasing their ruslts; and Sibyline Fracture, a documentary about the Gulf Oil Spill; as well as others.

This event is part of the Sacramento International Film Festival 2011.

title: Ward Anderson
description: Ward Anderson is a stand-up comedian, originally from Atlanta, now living in Toronto. He tours all over North America and acts and writes whenever possible. Ward's bestselling humour book, The Ultimate Bachelor's Guide is available in stores and online, and he has a comic memoir on the way. He's also appeared on TV here and there, mostly as himself on random talk and comedy shows.

title: Sacramento Comedy All Stars
description: Come out for an evening of entertainment by Sacramento's Comedy All Stars.

title: Screening: Toyland
description:
Toyland is the new documentary film that takes a never-before-seen look at a place where fun is born and competition is fierce: the $22 billion dollar toy business. Perform a song that sells a million copies and you're awarded a platinum record and the cover of Rolling Stone. Design a toy that sells 300 million copies and you're unknown...until now. Meet the people behind the biggest playthings in history including Slinky, Nerf, Play-Doh, Ant Farm, Lite Brite, Inch Worm, Mouse Trap, Twister, Toss Across, Kerplunk, Radio Flyer wagons, and more.

Follow the ups and downs of game designer, Tim Walsh as he tries to take his own invention to market, with nerve-racking pitches to Hasbro, Spin Master Toys, and others along the way. Will his idea light up the imagination of kids everywhere or never see the light of day? Welcome to Toyland.

title: Midnight Dream
description: Enjoy a performance by Midnight Dream.

title: Sarah Silverman Live
description:
Dubbed “the most outrageously funny woman alive” by Rolling Stone, Sarah Silverman has honed her comedic timing and sardonic sense of humor into a career that spans film (The School of Rock; There’s Something About Mary; Jesus Is Magic), television (Saturday Night Live; Crank Yankers; The Sarah Silverman Show), online videos, books, songwriting, and uproarious live performances. With an “aggressively silly, button-pushing comedy style” (The New York Times) that is equal parts provocation and social satire, Silverman riffs hilariously on race, religion, sexuality, and all sacred points in between.

Due to mature subject matter and language, we recommend this performance for mature audiences only.

title: Live Music by Rolling Fork Blues Revue
description:
Rolling Fork Blues Revue is a Northern California Band playing pure, classic blues. A four-piece combo including guitar, saxophone, bass, and drums, the Rolling Fork Blues Revue brings to life the classic Chicago blues of Muddy Waters and Howlin' Wolf, the Memphis sounds of B. B. King and Albert King, the Texas style of Freddie King, and the classic women's blues of Bessie Smith and Ida Cox.

Charles Oriel, on guitar and vocals, has been playing guitar and singing for 40 years. Bill Bua, on saxophone, is well versed in the jazz tradition. Together Charles and Bill trade dynamic solos and fills. Julia Simon, on bass guitar and vocals, has gigged in blues bands for 9 years. Bob Robbins, on the drums, creates a steady, in-the-pocket groove.

title: Grimey Tuesday with !!! (Chk Chk Chk) & Who Cares
description:
Grimey Tuesday is a dubstep & bass night featuring residents DJ Whores, Crescendo, MC Skurge, MC Bruce Lei, Jaytwo, and X-GVNR.

Upstairs:
-Sacramento's famous dance punks !!! (Chk Chk Chk) are back to rock upstairs at Grimey this time around! If you dont know em....you should. !!! will be stopping by Sacramento on their way to Coachella and will therefore bless us with a sweaty dance explosion that will blow your mind to smithereens.

-Sacramento's soon-to-be-famous jazz, funk, hip-hop band Who Cares is opening up for Chk Chk Chk for the first time at Grimey! Once again...if you arent familiar with these dudes....you def should be!

Downstairs:
-Man Machine is Fresh Machine (Who Cares) & new partner Game Genie. This duo has been killing the west coast with their DJ sets for the last year. This is Fresh Machine's third time playin' Grimey...if you've seen him before then you know that he's bringin' the heaters.

-Wherever the bass is, that's where Billy the Robotresides. Started mixing beats in 1993, formed Ninja Bass Squad with fellow bass head DJ Mantis (aka Matt Loomis) in the mid '90s.

-Ellis Rush is one half of Sac's dubstep crew Red Moon Empire and Eric 2 Percent's right hand man....Ellis delivers the goods.

Photos by: Lekkycharms Photos. Visuals by: Takeshi. Drink specials & low lows all night.

title: Lew Fratis Trio
description: Combine Lew Fratis, Kenny Nichols, and Dave Garrity and you get the Lew Fratis Trio--a very passionate group that will leave you wanting more. Their energetic styles on stage provide a show that is sure to electrify any crowd and leave them wanting more.

title: Hans Eberbach
description:
Eberbach started out as the lead singer of Sweet Vine and was with the group when it was picked up by Sony/Columbia's record label. Unfortunately, internal strife broke up the band in its prime. Now, after singing for Sweet Vine and Looking Star, Eberbach is doing his own thing.

Eberbach prefers to stay away from the traditional side of things, away from the love ballads and traditional band set-ups and even away from traditional sources of inspiration. "I've always heard music in everything," he says. "If you drop your fork and it hits this bottle and it makes this beautiful tone, I'm going to want to sample that in my music."

Eberbach is currently singing with three different groups—The Nibblers, Hans Eberbach, and Life As We Know It—and his two-man tour group, all with a different musical vibe.

title: Sacramento Kings Games at Hoppy
description:
Looking for a place to watch a Kings game in High Definition? As usual, Hoppy Brewing will be showing all of the Sacramento Kings games (if they are not blacked out by the NBA) via the NBA League Pass. In addition to the Kings games, we once again have the option to watch any NBA game this season. Also, as usual, we will suspend reservations during Kings games in the main dining area. Therefore, if you have a group of people and want a great seat for the game, make sure that your entire group arrives early!

And, don't forget, Hoppy has their Hoppy Hour daily 3pm-6pm and Late Night Happy Hour Sun-Wed 9:30pm-Close; Thurs-Sat 10:30pm-Close, so you can take advantage of $3.50 pints and $12 pitchers, with $2 appetizers during Late Night.

For a complete Kings schedule, click here.

title: Hoppy Hour
description:
Hoppy Brewing Company offers a daily Hoppy Hour as well as a special Late Night Hoppy Hour.

Both Hoppy Hours feature $3.50 pints and $12 pitchers. The Late Night Hoppy Hour includes a $2 Appetizer Menu to keep you sated after the kitchen closes. Items are: PB&J sliders, chips & salsa, bruschetta, mac & cheese, kettle chips, wings 'o' fire, calamari, buffalo sliders, and jalapeno bison cheese dogs. No to-go orders.

title: G. Love and Special Sauce
description: Tart, Tangy, Smooth, and oh so lip-smacking Sweet! Aaah yes, time to praise the almighty summer sippin' thirst quencher, being served straight up G. Love and Special Sauce style, ice cool and always refreshing. The Philly boys offer up soul drenched tracks pouring out their blues infused hip-hop, which people have been trying to label for years.

title: Karaoke Night
description: Enjoy an evening of Karaoke at Laughs Unlimited.

title: DJ Solomon
description:
Put on your party pants--DJ Solomon takes over M!X Downtown! Anyone can be a DJ. Or that’s how it might seem these days, given the proliferation of fist pumping knob-turners. But people who know music...who feel music...can easily distinguish between a laptop amateur and an electronic auteur. There’s a magic that happens in the space between, and that’s why people who know and feel and love music, love Solomon.

Solomon isn’t your everyday magician. He doesn’t know how to pull a white rabbit out of a hat, or your six of Clubs from the deck. But what the Bay Area-based DJ can do is elevate you on the dance floor. This was clear from the time of his first gig in ’89, when he used nothing more than a tape deck and CD player to transform a middle school prom into a raging pre-adolescent night club that terrified the chaperones. Ever since, he’s spread his innovative sound in clubs from here to China.

Solomon’s specialty is something he always called “Pop Turntablism.” It’s a niche of music that fuses scratching, beat juggling, word play, and live remixing with an eclectic mix of funk, soul, hip hop, house, and rock tracks. It’s a genre now popularly known as the mashup, and within this community, Solomon shines. He’s known to mix musical styles not only within their relative tempos, but also within their relative keys, allowing songs and genres to flow seamlessly from one to the next. And his stage presence is equally impressive. After so many years of performing live, he rocks the turntables with enough energy to spark a solar flare, blurring the lines between a DJ set and an epic rock show.

title: Jimmy Pailer
description: Jimmy Pailer is known as one of the most influential and talented blues guitarists in Northern California. He has been perfecting his craft for many years and it truly shows. Jimmy attracts attention wherever he plays because of his unique style and entertaining stage presence. He hails from St. Louis, Missouri, and has been blessed to share the stage with many famous and great Blues greats, such as Walter Trout, Tommy Castro, Leon Russell , Chuck Berry, Bobby Vega, Rare Earth, and Richie Hayward.

title: Acoustic Eclectic Jam Band
description: Newgrass,Traditional, Progressive, Rock, and Roots...yeah, Acoustic Eclectic Jam Band plays 'em all! An Acoustic band with driving instrumentals, original compositions, and vocal harmonies. Out of the box music!

title: Bob Wayne & The Outlaw Carnies
description: Dark stories of tussles with the law, drinking, fighting, cheating, murder, revenge, arson—these traditions date back further than black metal and dig deeper into the South than swamp water. With his leather vest, bandana, and revolving crew of banjo players, fiddle players, and upright bassists, Bob Wayne carries the torch for the outlaw country tradition with a modern punk snarl.

title: Tinie Tempah
description: Tinie Tempah has had an incredible year--few debut artists boast three hit singles, a Glastonbury performance on the Pyramid stage, and millions of YouTube views. He is officially certified as the best selling British debut act of 2010. Yet this 22 year-old artist has captivated music fans, celebrities, and critics alike in just a matter of months.

title: Steve McLane
description: Enjoy an acoustic performance by blues/folk musician Steve McLane.

title: Sacramento International Film Festival: Cine Soul
description:
Cine Soul is a component of the Sacramento International Film Festival dedicated to showcasing African-American cinema.

Highlights:
April 13: Cine Soul Part I
Mr. Dial Has Something to Say

April 14: Cine Soul Part II
Round on Both Sides
Revolutionary Microphone
Infiltrating Hollywood: The Rise and Fall of the Spook Who Sat by the Door

title: DJ Klever
description:
Join M!X Downtown as we present, DJ Whores and DJ Klever. M!X offers an intimate space, an awesome sound system, and tasty drink specials.

In the past five years, Klever has been performing his signature sets non-stop around the world (Taiwan, England, Ireland, Germany, New Zealand, Scandinavia, Australia, Japan, etc). He consistently amazes crowds and party-goers from 60 to 60,000 at world renowned venues such as (but not limited to) Miami's Ice Palace, Tai Pae's Ministry of Sound, NYC's Roxy and Irving Plaza, Club Fabric in London, numerous House of Blues venues throughout the U.S., El Rey Theatre in L.A., and Atlanta's Tabernacle. He has also showcased his skills at monumental events like the 2002 Winter Olympics in Salt Lake City, the Canadian Circa Skateboard Tour, Audiotistic in L.A., and the High Museum in Atlanta.

DJ A-Trak describes Klever as "one of the few and best DJs who can balance technical skill and party rocking. His style is energetic and air-tight."

title: I Love House: Donald Glaude
description:
A veteran DJ for over 15 years, Donald Glaude has cemented his reputation as a crowd-rocking favorite and one of the most in demand artists in the country. He is one of those rare DJs who perceives their role to be that of an all-around entertainer and performer. He exudes energy, dropping track after funky track, arms aloft, and has been known to join the dancers on the floor. It is the combination of these ingredients that have helped him create a unique connection with his audience.

Hosted by: Stephanie Weaver, Ron Reeser, Jetset Nights, Mixture Ent. (Mixing House and Electronic Music all night.) I Love House brings different guests every Thursday to District 30.

title: The DigiTour 2011
description:
The DigiTour is the first-ever large-scale, six-week, 27 city North American tour bringing your favorite-iconic YouTube musicians to life--off of the screen and onto the stage. The stellar line up features artists with a combined one billion views and over six million combined fan subscriptions, these artists include Dave Days, Auto Tune The News, David Choi, Destorm, Mystery Guitar Man, and Ricky Ficarelli.

Co-founders of The DigiTour Chris Rojas and Meridith Valiando say, “We are thrilled to give these YouTube musical sensations the opportunity to perform live in the first ever national tour featuring YouTubers - The DigiTour!"

title: 2 or 3 Guys
description: Critically misclaimed, universally ignored, 2 or 3 Guys are six feet under your underground scene and way before your time. You love 2 or 3 Guys. There were two of them, but then there was another. And then it was a band of sorts. Guys come and guys go and give a little or give a lot. The project goes away, sometimes for years, and then screams back to life. It doesn't want to die. Each new incarnation sounds almost nothing like the former but the names and melodies remain. What will the future hold for 2 or 3 Guys? Currently, the geek rockers sing silly songs in minor keys.

title: March of Dimes Benefit featuring Mick Martin
description:
Mick Martin, frontman of Mick Martin and the Blues Rockers delivers honest music fusing blues and rock.

This concert is a benefit for March of Dimes.

title: The CUF & Z-Man
description: Hip-hop crew The CUF, an acronym for California Underground Funk, is a 5-man wrecking crew comprised of MCs: N8 the Gr8, Pete, Crush, Brotha RJ, and Taktics (Lil N8). Z-Man is a rapper and the emcee of alternative hip-hop group One Block Radius.

title: Orgone & The Nibblers
description:
Los Angeles based band Orgone is many souls with a cosmic connection, a natural creative force, and musicians who have played together for years. They are self schooled and continue to shape their musical voice as a solid unit of guys who hang, spin records, and jam out their shared inspirations. They offer a rooted sense of funk, soul, afrobeat, deep rhythms, and an intimate understanding of DJ culture as well as each others' individual talents.

The Nibblers are a seven piece throwback to the grimy funk and soul of yore using a tasty mix of obscure retro favorites and original music to fill the dance floors. The members of the Nibblers have played in venues from New York to San Francisco and now are pooling their skills to shake selected California venues.

title: John Shipe & JD Valerio
description:
John Shipe alternates between acoustic and electric albums. He is confident on any stage, instrumentally clad in acoustic guitar, ukulele, or piano.

JD Valerio is a singer-songwriter with a body of work that comprises over 500 original, acoustic guitar-driven songs. His casual and unpretentious stage presence invites listeners to feel like they are part of the show, creating a genuine and “down to earth” good time.

title: Be Brave Bold Robot, The Inversions, Pilots Dare Me To Die
description:
Be Brave Bold Robot is soul coughing meets the Mountain Goats meets Bob Dylan meets Tom Waits meets the Counting Crows meets Calexico meets a good friend for a beer and a Bob Wilson lecture. SingerSongwriter songs about love and grandmothers and justice and life-affirming attitudes. Lots of sweat and passion, several different key meditations, and just enough tempo changes to keep things at least mildly interesting. Be Brave Bold Robot is a joyous celebration of sinful innocense, of deliberate absentmindedness, of social obligation that tries not to think too much of itself.


 

Also playing:
The Inversions
Pilots Dare Me to Die

title: Sacramento International Film Festival: Sac-Animation
description:
The Sacramento International Film Festival is proud to announce Sac-Animation, a showcase of computer and conventional animation from around the world.

This event is part of the Sacramento International Film Festival 2011.

title: The Bright Faces
description:
The Bright Faces are a four-person powerpop band from Sacramento.

Also playing:
The Parties
Blue Skies for Black Hearts
Jem & Scout

title: Sacramento International Film Festival: Surreal Cinema
description: The Sacramento International Film Festival 2011 is proud to announce Surreal Cinema, a showcase of surreal shorts from around the world. This year's lineup includes Halloween Spooky House from Japan and Cold Sore from England.

title: Goodness Gracious Me
description:
Goodness Gracious Me is a rock/garage/power pop band from Sacramento.

Also playing:
The Hi-Tones
OK Jose

title: Bone Mac Donald
description: Bone Mac Donald is a multi-instrumentalist, songwriter, and vocalist from Placerville. He is also one of the frontmen for the band Everyman Jack.

title: Chris Cain
description: Chris Cain's jazz-tinged, blues-soaked guitar and deep, warm vocals have the maturity and authenticity of bluesmen many years his senior. His expressive style is the result of a lifetime of study and the relentless pursuit of music mastery. His passion and intensity are a blend of his mother's Greek ancestry and his father's soulful black heritage.

title: The Bumptet and Friends
description:
The Bumptet conjures a sound that is both classic and modern, drawing on the blues, jazz, and folk roots of American music while cultivating the sense of power and urgency that make rock’n’roll so great. With an ever-growing repertoire of songs and sounds, The Bumptet has gained a reputation as an energetic live act not to be missed.

The Bumptet, featuring Sean Lehe, (Izabella), Jonathan Stoyanoff, (Johnny A., Global Funk Council), and Zack Bowden, (Jackie Greene, Chingus), brings a level of reckless sophistication to each performance with an improvisational, genre-bending approach to music. Their compositions range in style and complexity, moving from deep funk grooves to epic rock crescendos to intricate, fusion-esque unison lines and back again, with improvisation and an in-the-moment attitude as the only constants. They are certainly a group that must be seen live in order to fully appreciate the level of musicianship and soul they bring to every show they play.

title: Century's "Music 4 Music" Album Release Party
description:
MissChief Presents: Century's 29th Birthday Celebration & official Music 4 Music album release!

Hosted by the one and only Miss Ashleigh. Enjoy tunes spun by DJ Rated R and live band Red Velvet Kiss. Plus, performances by: Tribe of Levi (TPR), Skynet, Dreda Dre, Ms. Vybe, and a very special performance by Century featuring Ninja Oner.

There will be merchandise and giveaways from Shine Clothing. This is also a Journal Drive to support Auburn Hip Hop Congress giving Hip Hop Back to the youth! Bring a brand new journal and receive $2 off admission. Have a great night and give back at the same time!

title: Pushtonawanda
description:
Pushtonawanda is a Celtic-Soul Folk-Rock band from Sacramento.

Also performing:
Lucky and the Ten Balls

title: The Murder Room
description:
Wealthy Edgar Hollister marries Mavis Templeton who, after a few hours of blissful marriage, apparently tries various ways to kill him. The Murder Room is a comedy described as Abbot and Costello meet Agatha Christie with some Monty Python thrown in. It is a wild send up of every murder mystery ever written.

Director: Candi Pickering. Produced by special arrangement with Samuel French, Inc.

title: Walking Dead, The Left Hand, Dead Panic, The Nerv (SF)
description:
Walking Dead is a garage band from Sacramento.


 

Also playing:
The Left Hand
Dead Panic
The Nerv (SF)

title: Red Carpet Event for Sacramento SPCA
description:
It's the Red Carpet Event for Sacramento SPCA featuring Worst in Show, a documentary by John Beck & Don R. Lewis that goes behind the scenes of the annual World's Ugliest Dog Contest held annually in Petaluma, CA.

Following the film screening there will be a reception featuring meet & greet and Q&A with the four-legged stars, their owners, and the directors. Dog and pet-themed vendors, will be on site, too.

title: Deke Dickerson
description:
Deke Dickerson plays Country/Rockabilly/Surf.

Also playing:
Miss Lonely Hearts

title: Old Sacramento Speakeasy Tour & Pub Crawl
description:
If you are a fan of history and cocktails grab your friends for the Old Sacramento Speakeasy Tour and Pub Crawl. Downtown Sacramento Partnership tour guide and history buff, Shawn Peter, will take you on a guided tour unlike any other through Old Sacramento's underground watering holes. The tour begins at the River City Saloon, one of Oldtown's newest bars decorated in prohibition-era style. Your group will then head you to several other speakeasy hot spots, including famed Delta King riverboat, once a floating hotspot for prohibition drinking, jazz bands, and gambling.

Along the way, learn facinating tidbits about the people and events that shaped the city's early history as one of the wettest cities in the union during this pivitol era in American history. At each stop you can grab a prohbition-era cocktail or beer while you ponder Sactown's rich history and dirty little secrets.

This tour takes place on the 3rd Saturday of every month, rain or shine. Advance reservations required.

title: Albie Rockin' with Neckbone
description:
Harmonica virtuoso Midtown Ricky Ray Child, Bassist Jack Love, percussionist Curtis Blankenship, guitarist Patrick Child, and AJ Michel have been makin' some sweet sweet music! A little bit of original stuff, some sweet country, and a lot of blues along with good harmonies and impromptu jammin' make into some oooooh so good sounds and some really good times. There's always a party when Neckbone is in the house!

Also enjoy an appetizer potluck and raffle at this benefit for Albie Aware.

title: Mind X with Harvey Mandel
description: Mind X is Northern California's premiere groove-funk-bluegrass-jazz-psychedelic-rock band. They blend styles from across the spectrum of music and obliterate genre walls as they confidently chart new territories in live music.

title: The Athens
description:
The Athens features Peter Holden on lead vocals and guitar, Micah Bear on guitar and BG vocals, Rich Smith on bass, and Kurt Hardaway on drums. Although the band began to form more than a year ago with the meeting of Holden & Bear, things didn't start happening until Hardaway entered into the picture in the summer of '06. Rich stepped in on bass shortly afterwords.

As for the music, The Athens think of themselves as storyteller rock, with plenty of hooks to go around. If you think the music scene today is flooded with too many bands that don't have memorable songs, get ready to think differently. Peter describes the music as "a heavier version of Matchbox 20, along with hints of Marvelous 3 and The Replacements." So take a listen and get ready for something new. Pop music is back in Sacramento, and The Athens are going to make you believe it!

title: Kevin Seconds
description:
Enjoy performances by Kevin Seconds (of 7 Seconds) is a punk, folk, pop, americana, gospel musician.

Also performing:
Trackside Poets
Riot Radio

title: Chris 2Me and Friends
description: Enjoy a performance by Chris 2Me (of the band 2Me) and friends.

title: Sacramento International Film Festival 2011
description:
Filmmakers from all over the galaxy will soon descend on the state’s capital for the one and only Sacramento International Film Festival (SFF). Featuring a host of uncompromising documentaries, shorts, and feature films, this year’s Sacramento Film Festival  boasts our region’s greatest showcase of cinema art.

Screenings occur at the Crocker Art Museum & The Artisan Building's Theatre.

Select Individual Screenings:
-Sun, Apr 10: Environmental Visions at Artisan Theatre.
-Wed, Apr 13 & Thurs, Apr 14: Cine Soul at Artisan Theatre.
-Fri, Apr 15: Sac-Animation at Artisan Theatre.
-Fri, Apr 15: Surreal Cinema at Artisan Theatre.

See a complete schedule here.

title: Yonder Mountain String Band
description: Yonder Mountain String Band has always played music by its own set of rules. Bending bluegrass, rock, and countless other influences that the band cites, Yonder has pioneered a sound of their own. With their traditional lineup of instruments, the band may look like a traditional bluegrass band at first glance but they've created their own music that transcends any genre.

title: Johnny Sanchez
description: Johnny Sanchez is one of America's premier comedians. Having performed in comedy clubs for years, he has honed his comedy into an exquisite art form. With his feverish energy, detailed characters, and pinpoint delivery, his shows take you on a laughing journey of people, places, and life. Johnny's audiences are always captivated by his clever metaphors, inventive scenarios, and his all too true characters that are relatable and hilarious. He is a comedian who also transcends as a true performer.

title: E. Clark featuring Eric Hunter
description:
E. Clark is considered one of the most versatile comedians in Northern California, able to entertain in comedy clubs, colleges, churches, cruises, and corporate events. He has shared the stage with A-list comedians such as Dave Chappelle, Tracy Morgan, DL Hughley, and Tommy Davidson. Erik is the winner of the 2004 Sacramento Black Comedy Competition, has entertained our troops overseas, and can be seen in the comedic film The Hustle starring John Witherspoon.

The Thursday show is a fundraiser for the March of Dimes. The event is catered by Chic-Fil-A and will include a guest appearance by Justin Switzler.

title: Screening: Return to Babylon with Director Q&A
description:
Enjoy a screening of Return to Babylon with Director Alex Monty Canawati in attendance for a Q&A!

Return to Babylon is director Alex Monty Canawati's fast-paced, sexy, and often bitingly funny look at 1920s Hollywood and the scandals that rocked the silent-movie era. Hand-cranked and scored by piano true to form, Maria Conchita Alonso, Jennifer Tilly, Debi Mazar, Ione Skye, and Tippi Hedren light up the screen in this saucy silent film. Return to Babylon is an episodic film, stringing together the lives of scandalous Clara Bow (Jennifer Tilly), fiery Mexican film star Lupe Velez (Maria Conchita Alonso) and husband Johnny "Tarzan" Weissmuller, ill-fated Virginia Rappe (Ione Skye) and Fatty Arbuckle, Gloria Swanson (Debi Mazar), Ramon Navarro (Phillip Bloch), Josephine Baker (Rolonda Watts), Rudolph Valentino (Alex Monty Canawati), and a host of others.

title: David Jacobs-Strain
description: David Jacobs-Strain is a slide guitarist and modern roots singer-songwriter whose musical journey begins in the wellspring of Delta blues but ranges far afield from there. In his mid-twenties, he already channels age-old wisdom and heartache with such dexterity, energy, and passion that you feel good, even about feeling bad.

title: Reggae Bashment with DJ Wokstar
description: Reggae Bashment is an evening of reggae music with DJ Wokstar.

title: Best of Open Mic Showcase
description:
Every 1st Tuesday of the month Laughs Unlimited hosts the best open-mic showcase in Northern California. The show functions like the premier showcase clubs in Los Angeles and New York with 15-20 local amateurs and professional comedians performing short sets. It's like a comedy workout!

At the Best of Open Mic Showcase, the best of the best from our Open Mic Showcase are invited back to give a full 10 minute set of their best material! These up and comers have the skills but do they have the jokes?

title: Autumn Sky
description: Autumn Sky is an award-winning, multi-instrumentalist singer/songwriter from Sacramento. At twenty-two years old, she has been playing to the crowds of Sacramento for over five years and garnered much local acclaim for her lively and engaging shows, as well as her debut EP and album, Diminutive, Petite EP (2007) and All Which Isn't Singing (2008).

title: Styles of Paradise Launch Party
description: Come mingle with designers, stylists, models, and SFA (Sacramento State's Student Fashion Association) at the Launch Party the Tuesday before the Styles of Paradise Charity Fashion Show.

title: Doug Benson - Live CD Recording
description: It would take too long to cite all of his credits, but here's a small sampling: He has his own documentary called Super High Me based on a joke from his standup act, available on DVD. How does a little show called NBC's Last Comic Standing grab you? Fact: he finished top 6 in the 2007 season, no big deal. Doug is a series regular on VH-1's Best Week Ever. He also makes recurring appearances on ABC's Jimmy Kimmel Live.

title: Walking Spanish
description: If you're taking a walk through upper-middle class American suburbia, you wouldn't expect to hear solid, ripping, gut-busting rock and roll coming from a garage. But coming from a certain house in El Dorado Hills, CA are the sweet and smooth tones of the blues-driven, grunge-hashed, tight laced melodies of Walking Spanish.

title: Traditional Irish Jam Session
description: Everyone is welcome at this Traditional Irish Jam Session, hosted by Linda Relph.

title: DJ Andy Caldwell
description:
Every Thursday M!X brings you awesome electronic sounds from DJs across the country and even the world. This Thursday, M!X Downtown invites you to join us in welcoming special guest DJ Andy Caldwell!

As a songwriter, producer, classically trained pianist and trumpeter, remixer, DJ, and label owner (of the recently re-launched Uno Recordings), LA-based producer Andy Caldwell has thrown his hat into many rings over the course of his 15+ year career. Somehow, after circling the globe several times and playing more than 100 shows a year, Andy Caldwell also found the time to pen Grammy-nominated songs and even once shared the stage with James Brown. With so many musical reference points to choose from, and during one of the most turbulent periods in our planet's history, Andy Caldwell has shifted towards a tougher sound to match the times. Come see Andy and hear his music transformation!

title: The Resurrection Men
description: The Resurrection Men is a rock band consisting of Lucky Calloway (Vocals/Guitar), Chet Calloway (Drums), Baron Calloway (Guitar/Vocals), and Chester Calloway (Bass).

title: The Devil Makes Three
description:
The Devil Makes Three are quite possibly the best band that you have never heard of. They have been constantly on tour, selling out dates across the country and in their neck of the woods on the West Coast drawing near capacity crowds nightly. This is all word of mouth. For the past seven years, The Devil Makes Three have garnered fans the old school way, playing a city, making friends, conquering fans, and moving on.

With a slightly punky perspective on vintage American blues, The Devil Makes Three is a breath of fresh musical air on its eponymous Milan debut. Laced with elements of ragtime, country, folk and rockabilly, the critically praised, drummer-less trio–consisting of guitarist/frontman Pete Bernhard, stand-up bassist Lucia Turino and guitarist Cooper McBean–brings forth a genuine approach to acoustic music that is deeply steeped in rhythm.

title: Poetic Justis
description: Enjoy an acoustic performance by Poetic Justis.

title: Bill Cunningham New York: Opening Night Benefit
description:
The Crest Theatre is proud to announce the exclusive engagement of Bill Cunningham New York. This is the latest film in the Verge Center for the Arts quarterly screening at the Crest.

Opening night, which benefits the Verge Center for the Arts, begins with a Trunk Show in the Crest Theatre lobby featuring local boutiques and designers including Bows and Arrows, Modaspia, Crimson & Clover, Thunderhorse, and Babyfloss, while DJ Hailey provides ambience in the main house followed by the premiere screening of Bill Cunningham New York, and a post screening panel discussion with fashion bloggers Bella Q (Sac Street Style), Lorena Beightler (Sac Cycle Chic), and Kari Shipman (Juniper James).

About the film: The "Bill" in question is 80+ New York Times photographer Bill Cunningham. For decades, this Schwinn-riding cultural anthropologist has been obsessively and inventively chronicling fashion trends and high society charity soirées for the Times Style section in his columns "On the Street" and "Evening Hours." Documenting uptown fixtures (Wintour, Tom Wolfe, Brooke Astor, David Rockefeller—who all appear in the film out of their love for Bill), downtown eccentrics, and everyone in between, Cunningham’s enormous body of work is more reliable than any catwalk as an expression of time, place, and individual flair. In turn, Bill Cunningham New York is a delicate, funny, and often poignant portrait of a dedicated artist whose only wealth is his own humanity and unassuming grace.

title: Tom Rigney and Flambeau
description: After fifteen years as the leader and electrifying violinist of The Sundogs, fiddler/composer Tom Rigney steps out on his own with a hot new band, Flambeau. The repertoire is original, eclectic, passionate, and filled with a musical and emotional intensity that will come as no surprise to followers of Rigney’s career.

title: Joe Firstman
description:
California-based and North Carolina-raised singer-songwriter Joe Firstman released his newest album Live At The Treehouse in August 2010, via Rock Ridge Music. The album is not live in the sense of a traditional live album in front of an audience; rather, it was recorded in the studio (The Treehouse in Laurel Canyon outside Los Angeles) with Firstman playing and singing simultaneously to achieve a more live sound in the finished songs.

Says the Hermosa Beach, CA, Easy Reader of Firstman’s sound these days: “Firstman has stripped back his music from the ‘professional badass ninja’ full band ensembles of his early years to just his voice, guitar, and songs alone on the stage. Along the way, something fundamental has happened. Firstman’s early music was wildly exuberant, frenetic, sometimes frantic--‘one fluid flow of mania,’ as he has described it. Now he’s slowed it down. Every note counts. His music has grown more ragged, simple, and truthful.”

Also playing:
Mildrid
Marianne Keith

title: I Love You Mary Jane! Cannabis Cabaret
description:
A lively and entertaining jaunt through the cultural history of cannabis, I Love You Mary Jane! will be blowing through a smokescreen of social stigma for Sacramento audiences for the third installment of, The Siren Show, a progressive new cabaret series presented by the Sizzling Sirens Burlesque Experience.

The Sizzling Sirens have created a one-of-a-kind tribute themed to expose a variety of Mary Jane’s manifestations in American culture throughout time. From the plantation to the pot shop, I Love You Mary Jane! will deliver a serious dose of sizzle, featuring a brand new show format with a full evening of back-to-back cannabis-themed burlesque performances from the women of the Sizzling Sirens, plus smokin’ hot blues brought to you live by the Harley White Jr. Orchestra.

A true fusion of cannabis culture and Siren style satire and sensation, I Love You Mary Jane! promises to be an evening of live entertainment you surely won’t want to miss!

Visit our valued sponsors: Sac Burlesque Academy, P Street Health Center, Marie Young Photo, Isabella Corsetry, Makeup by Jennifer Haupt, Asbestos Press, Fantasy Frame Photography, and Romp Creative.

title: Pacific Guitar Ensemble
description:
The Pacific Guitar Ensemble consists of noted soloist and SFCM Guitar Department Chair David Tanenbaum, 11-string archguitarist Jon Mendle, Marc Teicholz, Michael Bautista, Lawrence Ferrara, Tony Kakamakov, and Paul Psarras. The group's repertoire features original music written by composers such as Brazilian guitar legend Sergio Assad, noted minimalist Belinda Reynolds, and the group's own brilliant steel-string stylist Peppino D'Agostino, as well as fresh arrangements of great composers from Bach to Brahms and Dowland to Rossini.

More info can be found on the band's website or, at Davis Art Center's website--a wonderful intimate venue, perfect for experiencing the rich tones of the acoustic guitar.

title: Cafe R&B
description: Cafe R&B plays blues that rocks and keeps on rocking! They all grew up immersed in rock music, with a heavy influence of British bands. Some of them had parents with a serious music appreciation that turned them on to blues, jazz, and country. Cafe R&B are a rock band to some and a blues band to others. They don't prohibit any of their influences from getting into their music if it feels good.

title: Honyock
description:
The name Honyock was a word the Hoffman brothers' (Mason and Spencer) Grandpa used to call them meaning "mischeivious young one." The band, who played their first show on June 19, 2010 (what would have been Grandpa Joes 78th birthday) was founded in the spirit of the honest man. Honyock works to produce well crafted, soul baring, honest music that comes from a pure place (no alterior motives).

Also performing:
Bypassing Oblivion

title: Jason & The Punknecks, The Cheatin' Hearts, Dry County Drinkers
description: Jason & The Punknecks' scumbag bluegrass is all the way from Tennessee! Joined by locals The Cheatin' Hearts and Dry County Drinkers.

title: High vs. Drunk Improv
description:
One high improv team. One drunk improv team. You vote on the team you think performs the best. Free munchies in the audience. Before you ask--Yes they are!

High: Brittany, Jason, Heather, Becca, Brian, Bailey

Drunk: Greg, Rachael, Mignon, Micaela, TBA

Hosted by Maz and Nick from Cage Match

title: Paul Mecurio with Special Guest Christina Pazsitzky
description:
A national headliner in clubs and theaters across North America and in Europe, Paul has performed at the prestigious Just For Laughs Comedy Festival in Montreal and has made numerous TV appearances including Comedy Central Presents, The Late, Late Show with Craig Kilborn, Late Night with Conan O'Brien, and numerous appearances on VH1's popular clip shows.

Paul makes regular appearances on CNN, CNNfn, and MSNBC as a political satirist. In 2001, as a writer for The Daily Show with Jon Stewart, Paul won the Emmy Award for Outstanding Individual Achievement In Writing In A Variety, Music, or Comedy Program. For his work on The Daily Show with Jon Stewart: Indecision 2000, Paul was honored with a Peabody Award for Excellence in Broadcasting (think The Pulitzer Prize for Broadcasting).
